g.text: No stored savings balance or streak.
sourceReferenceId points to Deposit for accrual,
streak and loyalty; to Gift for received points.
PointsService records expiry during a sweep.
Scope: business entities, selected fields and operations, selected enums.
Lines: logical associations by the named field; only “JPA” lines are object mappings.
Multiplicities describe normal application data, not SQL foreign-key constraints.
Repeated customerId links on Deposit, LoyaltyBonusPaid and Notification are shown as fields only.
- private; ~ package visibility; + public. Constructors and accessors omitted.
Controllers, services, repositories, DTOs and development-clock persistence omitted.
